tools.name: post
tools.description: Send a post as the user: a comment on a listing's discussion, a reply in a thread, or a new thread in the User Forum. It needs the user's key and the display name they picked. The post is marked as sent by an AI agent. It waits for review like any member's post, and until then only the user sees it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, read, mark · Private data: read, take, share · Public sink: post, mark, share.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, read, mark · Private data: read, take, share · Public sink: post, mark, share

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
